steps.detail: Speak to Helendis Riverhorn in Burning Steppes.

steps.detail: Follow the six-part investigation through the Burning Steppes chain to Marshal Maxwell at Morgan’s Vigil.

steps.detail: Enter Blackrock Depths and seek Marshal Windsor, or evidence of his fate.

steps.title: Abandoned Hope
steps.detail: Return to Marshal Maxwell after speaking with Windsor.

steps.title: A Crumpled Up Note
steps.detail: Find the note on Blackrock Depths enemies; deliver it to Windsor in his cell.

steps.title: A Shred of Hope
steps.detail: Recover Windsor’s information from Golem Lord Argelmach and General Angerforge in Blackrock Depths.

steps.title: Jail Break!
steps.detail: Escort Windsor out of Blackrock Depths; report to Marshal Maxwell.

steps.title: Stormwind Rendezvous
steps.detail: Speak with Squire Rowe at Stormwind’s gate to summon Windsor.

steps.title: The Great Masquerade
steps.detail: Help Windsor expose the deception in Stormwind; talk to Squire Rowe if Windsor is absent.

steps.title: The Dragon’s Eye
steps.detail: Follow Bolvar’s instruction to find someone who can prepare the amulet.

steps.title: Drakefire Amulet
steps.detail: Defeat General Drakkisath in Upper Blackrock Spire for the Blood of the Black Dragon Champion and finish the chain.
